title: Nested delegation preserves restrictions
description: Synthetic case: parent allows read on dataset-1; child may delegate only within its inherited grant.
policy_assumptions: Parent grants child read access to dataset-1 and permits further delegation within that exact scope.
Grandchild receives no broader action/resource scope.
The request is valid within the inherited scope.

expected.rationale: The nested request stays inside inherited action and resource scope.

review_notes: Review against the target system's actual policy and identity semantics.
This fixture is illustrative; it is not an implementation conformance result.
